newsitem.title: EU: EP PETITIONS COMMITTEE AGENDA - JAN 20-21.
newsitem.headline: EP PETITIONS COMMITTEE AGENDA - JAN 20-21.

text.p: COMMITTEE ON PETITIONS Monday 20 January 1997 and Tuesday 21 January 1997 1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE 220.652) A. PETITIONS ON WHICH THE COMMISSION HAS BEEN ASKED FOR INFORMATION Recognition of diplomas 2. No 606/94 by Rudolf BENEDIKTER, a lawyer (Italian) on behalf of Josef MAYR an engineer, on recognition of his qualifications (PE 211.870/rev.III) 3. No 287/95 by Mrs Audrey PFEIL (Irish) on recognition in Germany of academic qualifications obtained in Ireland (PE 215.909/rev.) 4. No 271/96 by Mrs Joanna ROULIN (British) on recognition of British hairdressing qualifications in France (PE 220.044) Freedom of movement 5. No 236/94 by Mr P. J. EVERS (Dutch) on legislation in the Netherlands relating to electric broadcasting equipment (PE 214.769/rev.II) 6. No 1110/95 by Mr Patrick LEE (Irish) on obstacles to Member State nationals wishing to practise as lawyers in Spain (public) (PE 220.029) 7. No 78/96 by Mrs Christiane NANI (French) on the interpretation of Council Directive 92/49/EEC on direct insurance other than life assurance (PE 218.913) No 79/96 by Mrs Solange AYRAL (French) on the interpretation of Council Directive 92/49/EEC on direct insurance other than life assurance No 86/96 by the French teachers of the European School in Brussels, bearing 16 signatures, on the interpretation of the third directive on direct insurance other than life assurance 8. (an ecological association), bearing 2471 signatures, on EU imports of wild birds 38. No 312/96 by Mr Ludwig STEININGER (German) on the feasibility study for the extension of the Munich/Verona rail link (PE 220.045) B. PETITION ON WHICH ANOTHER COMMITTEE HAS BEEN ASKED FOR INFORMATION 39. No 598/91 by the Sul e Ilhas Union of Banking Staff of Lisbon (Portuguese) concerning sex-based discrimination (The Legal Service has also delivered an opinion; the Committee on Women's Rights took account of this in its opinion) (Opinion: WOME) (PE 201.892/rev.II, PE 215.926, PE 218.919) 40. Any other business 41. Date and place of next meeting (The next meeting will be held on Monday 27 January 1997 at 3 p.m. and Tuesday 28 January 1997 at 9 a.m. in Brussels) END OF DOCUMENT.
